mechanism.base: Wood takes hold of earth by going into it. The old texts say the concentrated wins over the scattered, and a root is exactly that, one living line driven through loose ground until the ground stops sliding. The hillside loses nothing to the tree. It gains a shape, a grip, a reason to stay where it is. Soil left to itself spreads and settles flat, and a forest teaches it to stand.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Wood, nothing grows through the ground to hold it, and soil without roots spreads wherever it is pushed. Take on one demand with a date on it.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Wood, the roots draw more than the ground can feed, and the slope gives way under the trees it carries. Turn down the next demand and rest a week.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood makes it grow, a standard rising with you. As a catalyst, too little is asked of you from outside. The demands you live by are the ones you set yourself.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood builds it upward, stage by stage. As a friction, the demands stack up past what you can carry. You stay at attention long after the day is done, with little left for ease.
function.definition_balanced: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood makes it grow, a standard rising with you. In balance, the rules you answer to fit the life you are building. Your standards rise with you and still leave you free to rest.
function.advise_catalyst: You feel most like yourself when your effort has a name and an end. Sign up for one class that ends in a test. Pick one goal for this season and mark the finish on a calendar.
function.advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is light and warmth the ground takes in, so pressure turns into understanding. Let it soften what Wood presses on you. You meet every demand as if your standing hangs on it. Ask whoever made one rule why it matters to them. Tell one friend each week what is weighing on you.

candidates.cta_verdict: You make the rules you live by part of yourself, so over the years you value your standing as much as your work.

catalyst.clause: nothing grows through the ground to hold it
catalyst.remedy: Take on one demand with a date on it.

friction.clause: the roots draw more than the ground can feed
friction.remedy: Turn down the next demand and rest a week.

wide.clause: Wood is easy for you to reach, the roots that keep your ground from sliding.
wide.remedy: Use it. Say yes to the demand you have been avoiding.

missing.clause: Open hillside, not a tree on it, and the soil shifts under every plan you set down.
missing.remedy: Join one thing that keeps its own hours.

spared.clause: No trees stand on this ground, and the soil keeps all of itself.
spared.remedy: Leave it empty. Set your own pace.

thin.clause: A few roots in the ground, enough to grip and not enough to split it.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One rule you chose, no more.

excess.clause: Wood has outgrown the ground that feeds it, and the whole hillside slides.
excess.remedy: Rest first. Drop every demand you did not choose.

mechanism_yin.base: The concentrated prevails over the scattered, and so wood grips earth: roots thread the field, take hold, and do not ask permission. The ground carries what grows in it, season after season, the way a field carries its crop. It is a weight and a purpose at once. Unrooted ground is only dust waiting for wind.

retired_2026-09-21_overlaps.carry.spared.clause: Wood runs absent, and the soil is not drawn on: nobody rooted in you, nothing extracted.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Duty is your accountability function: how order, obligation, and living claims sit on you. With Wood running it, accountability in you grows: children, teams, gardens of people whose roots are in your ground. You hold rank by being held onto, and the grip that tires you is also what keeps your hillside from sliding. Prune the claims each season, keep the ones that fruit.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Earth, and Wood tames Earth: roots hold the hillside. Wood is the living demand that grips you, family, growth, obligations that keep growing back, and rooted ground is what a hillside is for. That is why Wood is your Order, the discipline that shapes you. Unclaimed ground erodes. Rooted ground becomes a terraced farm.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: A living deadline moves you: you work hardest when something planted depends on it.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Wood is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is living obligation that keeps you growing: family, teams, mentees, commitments that grow back each season and ask you to grow with them. Care is your discipline.

The garden, the godchild, the junior you did not have to take on: what depends on you organizes you, and the years shaped by a growing responsibility have been your best years so far.

Some people are structured by rules. You are structured by what you tend. Take on one responsibility that develops over years and let its calendar anchor yours. Show up on its schedule especially when you do not feel like it.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Wood is your Order, and as a friction, it is obligations multiplying past your ground: everyone rooted in you, nothing rooted for you, care extracted faster than it regrows.

Godparent to everyone, patient of no one. Four groups depend on your steadiness, the calendar is other people’s growth, and the requests keep arriving because you have never once let a season lapse.

Care that never rests its fields goes barren. List who actually needs you this season and hand one standing duty back, kindly and completely. Say a full yes to fewer things. Plant something that feeds you and give it the best hour.
